description: This PHP source file defines the 'LanguageDao' class within the 'OrangeHRM' project, responsible for database operations related to language entities. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and counting language data, utilizing Doctrine ORM query building and pagination.

classes.name: LanguageDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling language-related database operations, extending the base DAO functionality.

methods.name: saveLanguage
methods.description: Persists a Language entity to the database.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getExistingLanguageIds
methods.description: Fetches the IDs of existing languages matching a list of provided IDs.

methods.name: getLanguageByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its name.

methods.name: getLanguageList
methods.description: Returns a list of Language entities based on search filter parameters, utilizing pagination.

methods.name: getLanguageListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Paginator object configured for language search based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguageCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of languages matching the search filter criteria.

methods.name: deleteLanguages
methods.description: Deletes multiple Language entities based on their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLanguageName
methods.description: Checks whether a language with a given name already exists.
